$comment: Single source of path ownership (ADR 0004, decision log 2026-10-16). CI's path check (tools/path-check) and AGENTS.md both use this file.
Globs: '**' = any depth, '*' = within one path segment, otherwise an exact repo-relative path.
Branch rules: claude/* may change claude + claudeOnly + shared; codex/* may change codex + shared; main and tags are not checked; any other branch fails.
Every tracked file must match exactly one list. A new top-level path fails CI until it is classified here (a Claude-only change).
A package's own package.json is covered by its owner's 'packages/<name>/**' glob.
